# Neutrinos Designer

A Neutrinos brand + design skill pack for AI coding/design agents: websites and
app UIs, print PDFs, documents, presentations, and social graphics - grounded
in the official Neutrinos Brand Book, with the real logo, Poppins fonts, icon
library, and design tokens bundled.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `neutrinos-brand-core` | Source of truth: colors, typography, logo rules, design system, voice, bundled assets |
| `neutrinos-web` | Websites, landing pages, dashboards, app UIs |
| `neutrinos-print` | Print-ready PDFs (brochures, flyers, cards, posters) |
| `neutrinos-documents` | Handbooks, guides, job aids, reports |
| `neutrinos-presentations` | Pitch/sales decks (PPTX or HTML) |
| `neutrinos-social` | Social posts, banners, ads, email signatures |
| `neutrinos-handbook-pipeline` | Proven end-to-end pipeline for long branded PDFs |

## Install

**One command, any machine** — detects every AI harness and installs into all of them,
with a branded TUI (downloads the pack over HTTPS and verifies its SHA-256 first):

```
curl -fsSL https://neutrinos-designer.jitinnair.com/install.sh | bash
```

Remove it again with `curl -fsSL https://neutrinos-designer.jitinnair.com/install.sh | bash -s -- --remove`.

**Any Agent Skills harness** (recommended when you have Node.js — installs to every harness it knows):

```
npx skills add jitin-neutrinos/neutrinos-designer --all -y
```

**Everything at once** — clone the repo, then detect and install into every harness,
including Claude Code plugin registration and the single-file rules artifacts that
Tier-2 harnesses (Cursor, Copilot, Continue) read:

```
python tools/install.py install --dry-run   # preview
python tools/install.py install --yes       # apply
```

**Claude Code plugin**: `/plugin marketplace add jitin-neutrinos/neutrinos-designer`
then `/plugin install neutrinos-designer@neutrinos`.

This repository is **private**: harnesses install from it with your normal git
credentials (the `gh` CLI credential helper is sufficient).

After editing a skill, re-run the installer (or `npx skills add ...`) — harnesses read
the installed copy, not this working tree, so a repo edit alone changes nothing.

## Verify / maintain

```
python tools/validate.py        # spec + links + tokens + portability checks
python tools/install.py verify  # assets resolve from every install location
python tools/install.py doctor  # duplicates, drift, dangling marketplaces
python tools/selfcheck.py       # PDF render pipeline check
```
